title: Left hand, Gulf Coast job, Smiley Lewis, California, St. Louis, boogie-woogie
summary: One very long block: Tuts on his strong left hand, Brother Montgomery and Dupree, his birth in 1907, the Isaiah Morgan band on the Gulf Coast, a trip to California in the 1940s, Smiley Lewis and his recordings, St. Louis, learning boogie-woogie from records, Wade Tait, and Red Cayou's real name.
